paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
coupling_convention: decay rate Gamma in s^-1 (axis read-back)
notes: Paper presents PROJECTED (Fisher forecast) HERA 21-cm power spectrum sensitivity to decaying dark matter, expressed as 95th-percentile lower limits on the DM lifetime tau (reaching ~1e28 s) versus DM mass for two channels: monochromatic decay to photons and to e+e- pairs. The photon-decay channel corresponds to the axion-photon parameter space (tau convertible to g_agamma via Gamma = g^2 m^3/(64 pi)), consistent with the pre-analysis hint, but the actual limit curves are only shown in Fig. 8 with no numerical table or explicit values in the text. Only a rough anchor ('lifetimes ~1e28 s' for sub-GeV e+e- decays) is quoted, insufficient to reconstruct the mass-dependent curve. No data points extracted; digitization of Fig. 8 would be required.
